summary_1line: Vidura urges Dhritarashtra to accept Krishna’s peace mission and grant the Pandavas justice, while Duryodhana instead plots to imprison Krishna.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the royal court, Duryodhana boldly declares his plan to imprison Krishna while shocked elders look on in alarm.
Vidura stands before the blind king Dhritarashtra, warning him that Krishna cannot be separated from Arjuna by wealth or deception.
Bhishma rises in anger in the Kuru court, condemning Duryodhana’s wicked plan to seize Krishna.
